Across industries, cybercriminals are posing as company recruiters using fake job postings and employment offers to trick people into providing personal information or payment. Be alert and never provide personal/financial information or payment to anyone claiming to offer a job opportunity. During the recruiting process, RSM US will never: 
 
	• Ask you for payment to process documents, purchase equipment, or for any other reason.
	• Request your banking or credit card information
	• Send you a check to purchase your own equipment 
 
If you believe you are a victim of a job scam, it’s recommended that you report it to law enforcement, contact your financial institution and notify the website in which the job was listed.

Like Tzinga, our flagship energy drink that students and all-nighter urban animals swore by; Or Paper Boat, which brings a sunny smile and innocent memories, as you sip through these treasured recipes.

Any drink can be made to taste good. Or feel nutritious. But how many drinks tell a story? Because when companies get together and dole out a drink to the parched populace, it’s practicality. But when history and geography conspire to make a drink favoured through the ages, that’s destiny.

A culmination of efforts. Modified through trial and error. Perfected with every passing age. From a king’s royal cook to a soldier’s flask to a peace offering made by warring clans to a mother conjuring something special for her son’s return to a grand celebration of harvest. Everyone had something to contribute. And it’s their additions (and subtractions) that ultimately made their way into food carts in village fairs.

And while we’ve all experienced the joy of tasting these drinks at these carts at one point or the other, we’ve also experienced the often awful gastronomical aftermath of these little joys.

Our inspiration for Paper Boat lies in emulating these tastes and experiences standing tall on a benchmark of hygiene and safety. Getting the good moments out to you while avoiding the unpleasant bits.

So go on ahead, make new memories. We’ll watch your back.

宁德时代总部位于福建省宁德市。公司在全球已设立福建宁德、江苏溧阳、青海西宁、四川宜宾、广东肇庆、上海临港、福建厦门、江西宜春、贵州贵阳、山东济宁、德国图林根州埃尔福特、匈牙利德布勒森十二大电池生产制造基地，同时在德国慕尼黑、法国巴黎、日本横滨、美国底特律等地设有子公司。

宁德时代的发展目标是以先进电池和风光水等可再生能源的高效电力系统，替代传统化石能源为主的固定和移动能源系统，并以电动化+智能化为核心，实现市场应用的集成创新。为此持续在材料及材料体系、系统结构、极限制造以及商业模式四重维度突破创新。

2022年上半年，宁德时代营业收入1130亿元，同比增长156%，净利润82亿元，同比增长82%。动力电池系统和储能系统营收同比增长分别为160%和171%，境外电池业务营收同比增长123%。根据SNE Research数据统计，宁德时代动力电池使用量连续五年排名全球第一，2022 年上半年全球市占率达 34.8%，拥有全球最广泛的整车厂合作伙伴。根据ICC鑫椤资讯数据，2021年宁德时代储能电池产量市占率全球第一。

宁德时代重视研发，已在宁德、溧阳、上海、厦门以及德国慕尼黑设立了五大研发中心。 2022年上半年，研发费用58亿元，同比增长107%。研发人员共有12132名，其中博士193名，硕士2233名。研发能力涵盖材料研发、产品研发、工程设计、测试分析、智能制造、信息系统、项目管理等各个领域。公司拥有电化学储能技术国家工程研究中心、福建省锂离子电池企业重点实验室、中国合格评定国家认可委员会（CNAS）认证的测试验证中心，以及聚焦能源存储转化领域前沿基础问题研究的21C创新实验室，并设立了“博士后科研工作站”“福建省院士专家工作站”等。公司拥有及正在申请的国内外专利合计12924项，主导或参与制修订超过70项国内外标准。

2021年，宁德时代被世界经济论坛评选为“灯塔工厂”，宜宾基地获得全球首个电池零碳工厂认证。宁德时代立足技术领先优势和供应链整合能力，构建电动化和智能化相结合的新能源产业生态，已推出光储充检智能充电站、电动船舶、电动智慧无人矿山、重卡换电等创新解决方案。换电服务品牌EVOGO推出组合换电解决方案，正陆续在全国落地运营，通过打造基于车电分离模式下的电池租购、换电运营、回收等新商业模式，实现电池全生命周期服务闭环。未来。宁德时代将积极践行社会责任，为全球新能源事业发展做出卓越贡献。

d:
The infinite scroll is lonely. We are fixing the "Alone Together" bug.

Current social media architectures optimize for isolation, trapping users in personalized reality tunnels that maximize retention but degrade social health. At Shoal, we are building the antidote: the first Synchronous Social System.  

We are not a broadcast platform. We are the digital living room where short form content is consumed actively, not passively. We combine the creator-driven depth of a content repository with the intimate, high-fidelity connection of a video hangout.  

Our Core Philosophy: Boids, Not Bots.

Inspired by the biological behavior of shoaling fish, our platform prioritizes organic social cohesion over algorithmic manipulation. We are building for "Co-Presence," ensuring that users maintain agency while moving together as a unit.  

The Shoal Experience:
🐟 The Room of 6: We cap participation at six users—the "support clique" limit defined by Dunbar’s number. This ensures true interaction and "dinner party" dynamics rather than chaotic noise.  

⏭️ The Leaderless Skip: We gamify consumption with a radical "Veto Power." Any user in the room can skip the video for everyone instantly. There are no passive viewers; if the content isn't good enough for the group, the group moves on. 
 
⚡ Synchronous Engagement: From "Hover Chat" overlays that sit atop the video to "Group Timelines" that sync every scrub and seek, we mask technical latency to create the illusion of perfect togetherness.  

🧬 Vibe Vectors: Our matching engine doesn't just look for friends; it scans for "Vibe." We connect users based on the intersection of their social graph and real-time interest vectors, solving the "cold start" problem for digital hangouts.
